{{Quote|They were first cousins, twice removed. Or was it once removed? It's kind of confusing because my grandfather married his niece&hellip;|Tyrak, on his parents|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
The '''father''' of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Tyrak lineage]]. Tyrak's father [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Tyrak's mother|woman]] who was also a member of the family&mdash;his first cousin either once or twice removed&mdash;and the two had a son, Tyrak, together. As a result of the incestuous relationships of their family, Tyrak himself was mildly deranged.
